thread:
maya: Heads-up - Acme is seeing intermittent 502/504s hitting the hosted inference endpoint during long-lived streaming chats. Started ~12:30 UTC, customer reports ~15% of requests failing, mostly long sessions with function calls and attachments. They gave trace ID 42-9a7c.
rahul: Can you paste the trace ID and a sample request? we should check edge logs + auth service traces.
maya: Trace: 42-9a7c. Sample request (redacted): `POST /v1/chat.stream` streaming with `Transfer-Encoding: chunked`, includes function call step and intermittent client disconnects. Customer says failures spike when they upload small binary blobs inside messages.
ops-bot: Alert: edge-proxy upstream_reset_rate increased to 5x for service hosted-api-us-east in cluster frontdoor at 2026-03-15T12:31:09Z.
jordan: I’m seeing a correlation in frontdoor logs: many upstream resets (RST_STREAM) followed by Envoy returning 502 to client. Example log snippet: ```[timestamp] proxy=frontdoor-1 upstream=auth-proxy-12 rst=RST_STREAM stream=193 reason=REFUSED_STREAM```
emily: Also saw auth service 429 spikes around same time but not all 429s map to client 429 — some become 502s. Could be retry/fanout code path.
rahul: Hypothesis: new retry logic in auth-proxy retries on 429 for token refresh but keeps the same downstream stream open, causing HTTP/2 stream id reuse and downstream RSTs when upstream pool saturates. Need to verify connection counts and max concurrent streams.
maya: Repro steps from customer (they gave): 1) Open long chat stream 2) Send message with 2 function calls and 1 attachment 3) Rotate API key client-side mid-stream 4) continue streaming -> ~20% chance of immediate 502.
jordan: I queried frontdoor metrics: concurrent_http2_streams peaked at 1100 (config limit 1024). There's a steady tail of REFUSED_STREAM on the busy frontdoor instances.
emily: Stacktrace from auth-proxy shows `attempt_retry_on_429()` path invoked, see snippet: ```if (resp.status==429) { retry_with_backoff(); } // does not teardown original stream``` Might be leaving half-open streams.
rahul: Quick mitigation: bump max concurrent streams and set envoy config to fail-fast on upstream 429s so we don't keep client streams open. Also temporary rollback of the auth-proxy retry change.
maya: Customer on call, can we try a quick rollback / config tweak? They are sensitive.
jordan: Rolling back auth-proxy change in canary now: `kubectl rollout undo deploy/auth-proxy -n prod --to-revision=42` Applying to 2 pods first.
ops-bot: Deploy event: rollback started for auth-proxy by jordan at 2026-03-15T12:38:21Z.
emily: After rollback, frontdoor upstream_reset_rate dropped ~80% within 2 minutes. Customer reports drop in 502s, they see ~1% now.
rahul: Good. We'll keep rollback and schedule a follow-up: we need a safer retry that closes client streams before retrying, and add probe that simulates mid-stream key rotation + attachments.
maya: Can SRE add a synthetic test that exercises mid-stream key rotate with chunked uploads? put it in oncall runbook.
jordan: Added to runbook: `test/edge/mid_stream_key_rotate.py` harness and set alert threshold for concurrent_http2_streams > 900.
emily: Follow-ups: 1) postmortem notes (root cause: retry-without-teardown on 429 + http2 stream limits) 2) add unit/integration tests 3) add customer-specific mitigations (we'll whitelist their traffic for dedicated lower-risk route)
maya: Thanks team. I'm updating the customer slack ticket with mitigation steps and ETA. Will keep thread updated. :thumbsup:
